items.name: andromeda-button

Transparent hairline surfaces sit on a near-black canvas, with an electric-blue accent that brightens and glows on interaction. Free account required to install; source is free to read.

items.name: meet-the-crew
items.title: Meet the Crew
items.description: A swipeable portrait card stack perfect for introducing a team, showcasing crew members, or picking an avatar. Four stacked cards fan out with soft rotations: drag to browse, tap to choose. Drop in your own photos and names for an About Us section, a character selector, or an onboarding profile picker. Free account required to install; source is free to read.
